India's Ram Temple Climb Case Raises Questions About Corruption and Justice

The recent arrest of alleged temple climbers in India's Ram Temple climb case has raised questions about corruption, justice, and the government's response. The case involves allegations of property purchases and cash seizures linked to one of the accused. The opposition party has criticized the government's handling of the case, while some politicians have made accusations against the ruling party.
